title: Compute Atlas: a source-cited dataset of U.S. data centers, crypto-mining sites, and dedicated power generation
description: Compute Atlas is a curated, human-moderated dataset tracking AI and traditional data centers, crypto-mining operations, and dedicated power-generation facilities built to supply them, across the United States. Every record traces to a real, citable public source — press coverage, filings, permits, or government data — and spans the full project lifecycle from proposed through operational.
